verdict.rationale: MoonPay's REST API (sessions, quotes) and Web SDK clearly abstract blockchain nodes, gas, and chain mechanics behind conventional endpoints and a test-mode sandbox (moonpay-docs-14,15,26,46), and OpenAPI-based codegen is documented for generating type-safe clients (moonpay-docs-28). However, evidence only shows a single official Web/JS SDK, not client libraries across multiple developer languages, and a probe found no OpenAPI spec at the expected public paths (moonpay-probe-2), undercutting the codegen claim. Missing for 10: confirmed multi-language SDKs/client libraries beyond JavaScript, and a publicly reachable OpenAPI spec to back the codegen claim.
